********Position Overview:**
 MP embraces an owner operator culture, and the Data Analyst will be empowered to develop and maintain the Company’s reporting and analytics portfolio in collaboration with the broader analytics team. This position will possess a unique view of the business and support manufacturing, engineering, finance, and other functional teams in developing and analyzing operational performance, resource allocation, and future planning. The Data Analyst will be a key member of MP Magnetics analytics team.
   

  

**Position Responsibilities:**
* Collect, clean, and integrate data from multiple disparate sources, including ERP systems, production systems, and financial platforms, for use in manufacturing analysis and reporting.
* Develop advanced reports, dashboards, and visualizations to monitor manufacturing performance, operational efficiency, and financial KPIs.
* Perform in\-depth statistical and trend analysis on production, inventory, and cost data to identify opportunities for process optimization and cost reduction.
* Interpret complex datasets and present actionable insights with clear distinction between data\-driven facts and business recommendations.
* Support enterprise\-wide analytics initiatives, including predictive modeling and process optimization projects.
* Work with engineering teams to gather and analyze process data in the context of underlying physical parameters, helping drive fundamental understanding of process performance on a first principles basis.


**Other Functions:**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand analytical needs.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, weekly manager reports, and recurring analysis.
* Develop statistical analysis using large disparate data sources to form new insights and support data\-driven decision processes.
* Provide weekly and monthly reports and analyses for senior leaders.
* Manage aspects of the analytical architecture and collection of manufacturing data.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Basic Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Finance, Computer Science, or related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment or with manufacturing data analytics; public company experience is a plus.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, operational KPIs, and cost structures.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques, including advanced SQL, Power BI, Python, KNIME or similar tools preferred.
* Ability to work with large, complex datasets from multiple sources and deliver clear, actionable insights.


**Desired Qualities:**
* Must be highly analytical, intellectually curious and a fast learner.
* Ability to identify objectives, collect and process data, analyze and interpret results, and present conclusion and recommendations.
* Must be self\-directed, highly collaborative, and able to handle a variety of responsibilities.
* Ability to work with all levels within the organization, including senior management.
* Ability to work with internal customers and external agencies for compliance and controls.
* Strong verbal and written presentation skills.
* Familiarity with, or keen interest in learning about, mining, manufacturing, and industrial processes.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER SENIOR

Transform technology into opportunity as a Software Engineer Senior at GDIT. Shape what’s next for mission-critical government projects while shaping what’s next for your engineering career.

 Extensive software development experience with Java

 Experience using an integrated development environment such as the Atlassian plugin software developer kit (SDK) or Visual Studio Code (VS Code)

 Experience with IaC principles and automation tools such as Ansible

 Experience creating documentation of configurations, procedures, and system changes

 Experience with CI/CD principles, methodologies, and tools such as GitLab CI

 Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker

 Experience deploying containerized services under Kubernetes orchestration

 Experience with Git for source code management, branching strategies, and team collaboration

- Position Desired Skills:

 Experience with the Atlassian Tool Suite (JIRA, Confluence)

 Experience with sustaining mission applications deployed in a Linux environment

 Experience with interacting/training external customers
